title: The Food With the Highest Glyphosate (Roundup)
summary: Short video on foods with high glyphosate exposure, saying organic helps but does not guarantee glyphosate-free food.

assertions.quote: just because it's organic doesn't mean it's 100

verdicts.note: Drift and contamination mean low glyphosate residues are sometimes found on organic products, though far less often than on conventional ones.

The 5-percent-of-tolerance exclusion in 7 CFR 205.671 means organic food may legally carry trace residues of prohibited pesticides such as glyphosate; the rule shows this is allowed, not how often it occurs.

assertions.quote: just because they resist the pesticide doesn't mean they're not going to spray this chemical on that food

verdicts.note: Glyphosate-tolerant crops are sprayed and can carry residues, though highly refined products such as oils and sugar contain little.

assertions.quote: these weeds that they're spraying to kill with this glyphosate are becoming also resistant to roundup so that means they have to spray more
